strings.v: The Throne feature is not yet available for this Deity. Stay tuned.
[Throne Lv.10]Zeus gains a permanent Thunder Echo at the start of battle. The Thunder Echo inherits 30% of all of Zeus's stats.
[Throne Lv.20]The Thunder Echo inherits 60% of all of Zeus's stats.
[Throne Lv.30]When Zeus is about to fall, sacrifices the Thunder Echo to become Invincible for 3s and recovers 60% Max HP. Triggers once per battle.
[Throne Lv.40]The Thunder Echo inherits 70% of all of Zeus's stats.
[Throne Lv.10]Divine Embrace also grants the target 30% ATK for 5s.
[Throne Lv.20]Divine Embrace also grants the target 40% ATK for 5s.
[Throne Lv.30]For each summoned unit on the battlefield, the Shield Power granted by Nuwa increases by 10%.
[Throne Lv.40]Divine Embrace also grants the target 50% ATK for 5s.
[Throne Lv.10]Vintage Vivace takes effect on 1 additional unit.
[Throne Lv.20]Vintage Vivace additionally restores HP equal to 200% of ATK.
[Throne Lv.30]Vintage Vivace takes effect on 3 additional units.
[Throne Lv.40]Vintage Vivace additionally restores HP equal to 250% of ATK.
[Throne Lv.10]When the battle starts, reduces the Hit Rate of all enemy units by 30% for 15s.
[Throne Lv.20]Nyx deals 40% increased DMG to units with HP above 30%.
[Throne Lv.30]When the battle starts, reduces the Hit Rate of all enemy units by 30% for 30s.
[Throne Lv.40]Nyx deals 45% increased DMG to units with HP above 30%.
God of the Sun and Secrets
Throne of the Hidden Blazing Sun
[Throne Lv.10]During Aten's Radiance, each solar blade fired grants the most vulnerable ally a shield equal to 50% of ATK for 3s.
[Throne Lv.20]When the battle starts, Glare of Ra takes effect on an additional ally, prioritizing front-row allies.
[Throne Lv.30]During Aten's Radiance, DMG dealt becomes True DMG.
[Throne Lv.40]During Aten's Radiance, each solar blade fired grants the most vulnerable ally a shield equal to 60% of ATK for 3s.
[Throne Lv.10]When casting Bloodstained Bond, also grants a shield to the frost-linked ally. This shield's effectiveness is only 30%.
[Throne Lv.20]Casting Shackle of Pain permanently increases the target's DMG taken by 10%, up to 3 stacks.
[Throne Lv.30]When casting Bloodstained Bond, also grants a shield to the frost-linked ally. This shield's effectiveness is only 60%.
[Throne Lv.40]Casting Shackle of Pain permanently increases the target's DMG taken by 15%, up to 3 stacks.
[Throne Lv.10]In the Bound state, DMG taken is reduced by an additional 20%.
[Throne Lv.20]Gains 200 initial Energy when the battle starts.
[Throne Lv.30]In the Bound state, DMG taken is reduced by an additional 40%.
[Throne Lv.40]Gains 200 initial Energy when the battle starts.
[Throne Lv.10]Each Whirlwind of Howling Hurricane reduces the target's Armor and M-RES by 10% for 15s, up to 10 stacks.
[Throne Lv.20]When Grand Nosedive reaches max stacks, additionally increases CRIT DMG by 45%.
[Throne Lv.30]Each Whirlwind of Howling Hurricane reduces the target's Armor and M-RES by 20% for 15s, up to 10 stacks.
[Throne Lv.40]When Grand Nosedive reaches max stacks, additionally increases CRIT DMG by 50%.
[Throne Lv.10]When the linked unit with the highest HP is about to fall, gains a shield equal to 200% of the ATK of the linked unit with the highest ATK.
[Throne Lv.20]When the linked unit with the highest ATK is about to fall, gains a shield equal to 20% of the Max HP of the linked unit with the highest HP.
[Throne Lv.30]When the linked unit with the highest HP is about to fall, gains a shield equal to 300% of the ATK of the linked unit with the highest ATK.
[Throne Lv.40]When the linked unit with the highest ATK is about to fall, gains a shield equal to 30% of the Max HP of the linked unit with the highest HP.
[Throne Lv.10]If Underworld Arbitration kills an enemy, Yanluo gains 10% of that unit's ATK (up to 1000% of his own ATK).
[Throne Lv.20]If Underworld Arbitration kills an enemy, Yanluo gains 20% of that unit's ATK (up to 2000% of his own ATK).
[Throne Lv.30]Underworld Arbitration increases DMG dealt to enemies with HP below 50% by 50%.
[Throne Lv.40]If Underworld Arbitration kills an enemy, Yanluo gains 25% of that unit's ATK (up to 2500% of his own ATK).
[Throne Lv.10]Golden Ingot additionally grants the target a shield equal to 300% of Caishen's ATK.
[Throne Lv.20]Golden Ingot additionally grants the target a shield equal to 400% of Caishen's ATK.
[Throne Lv.30]The trigger range of Endless Fortune becomes the entire battlefield.
[Throne Lv.40]Golden Ingot additionally grants the target a shield equal to 500% of Caishen's ATK.
[Throne Lv.10]Isis's Basic ATK fires an additional arrow that deals DMG to a random target and can trigger on-hit effects. This DMG is equal to 30% of the original DMG.
[Throne Lv.20]Isis gains 600 Energy upon entering battle.
[Throne Lv.30]The arrow deals DMG equal to 50% of the original DMG.
[Throne Lv.40]The arrow deals DMG equal to 55% of the original DMG.
[Throne Lv.10]Fengyi gains 50% CRIT Rate when gaining a Whirlwind for the first time.
[Throne Lv.20]Fengyi's CRIT hits ignore 80% of the target's Physical & Magical Resistance.
[Throne Lv.30]Each stack of Whirlwind additionally grants Fengyi 70% CRIT DMG.
[Throne Lv.40]Each stack of Whirlwind additionally grants Fengyi 75% CRIT DMG.
Goddess of the Moon and Oak
[Throne Lv.10]When a unit with the Waxing Blessing effect participates in killing an enemy unit, the effect's duration is extended by 5s.
[Throne Lv.20]The Waxing Blessing effect additionally increases CRIT Rate by 20% and Hit Rate by 30%.
[Throne Lv.30]Reduces the CD of Waxing Blessing to 10s.
[Throne Lv.40]The Waxing Blessing effect additionally increases CRIT Rate by 30% and Hit Rate by 40%.
[Throne Lv.10]When an allied Deity unit is killed, Pan curses the killer, inflicting Shepherd's Dread on them for 5s.
[Throne Lv.20]When an allied Deity unit is killed, Pan curses the killer, inflicting Shepherd's Dread on them for 5s and increasing their DMG taken by 30%.
[Throne Lv.30]Pandean Pipes inflicts Daze on an additional unit.
[Throne Lv.40]When an allied Deity unit is killed, Pan curses the killer, inflicting Shepherd's Dread on them for 8s.
[Throne Lv.10]Enemies hit by Gale-Force Shot have their Physical & Magical Resistance reduced by 5% for 10s, up to 10 stacks.
[Throne Lv.20]Gains 300 Energy when Hunter's Snare is triggered.
[Throne Lv.30]Enemies hit by Gale-Force Shot have their Physical & Magical Resistance reduced by 10% for 10s, up to 10 stacks.
[Throne Lv.40]Gains 400 Energy when Hunter's Snare is triggered.
[Throne Lv.10]For every 10% Max HP lost, Jormungandr gains 5% ATK, up to 50% (this ATK can be inherited by its corpse at 30% efficiency).
[Throne Lv.20]For every 10% Max HP lost, Jormungandr gains 10% ATK, up to 100%.
[Throne Lv.30]Gains Super Armor during the Serpent's Approach dash.
[Throne Lv.40]For every 10% Max HP lost, Jormungandr gains 20% ATK, up to 100%.
[Throne Lv.10]Each Heal from the Return of the Maiden effect additionally restores own HP equal to 50% ATK.
[Throne Lv.20]Return of the Maiden trigger count +1.
[Throne Lv.30]Each Heal from the Return of the Maiden effect additionally restores own HP equal to 85% ATK.
[Throne Lv.40]When Return of the Maiden is triggered, grants her a shield equal to 500% of ATK.
[Throne Lv.10]Converts 25% of Freya's Overhealing into a shield (up to 100% of the target's Max HP).
[Throne Lv.20]When an allied unit's HP falls to 50% Max HP, Freya restores HP equal to 500% of her ATK for them. Triggers only once.
[Throne Lv.30]Freya's Overhealing is converted into a Shield at 35% efficiency.
[Throne Lv.40]Freya's Overhealing is converted into a shield at 40% efficiency.
[Throne Lv.10]For 8s after Underworld Soulfarer is triggered, the target takes 30% increased DMG.
[Throne Lv.20]For 8s after Underworld Soulfarer is triggered, the target takes 50% increased DMG.
[Throne Lv.30]Featherfall Judgment deals 45% increased DMG, and the Execute granted by the Relic is increased to 10% of Max HP (ineffective if this Relic effect is not unlocked).
[Throne Lv.10]Effect enhanced in the Rise From Ashes state: Additionally restores 5% Max HP per second.
[Throne Lv.20]Effect enhanced in the Rise From Ashes state: Additionally restores 12% Max HP per second.

[Throne Lv.30]When Phoenix revives from the Rise From Ashes state for the first time, 40% of DMG dealt is converted into True DMG. Each subsequent Rise From Ashes increases the conversion rate by 20%, up to 100%.
[Throne Lv.40]Effect enhanced in the Rise From Ashes state: Additionally restores 15% Max HP per second.
[Throne Lv.10]The Dunes' Bloodrage effect increases the Dodge Rate of allied units by 10%.
[Throne Lv.20]The Dunes' Bloodrage effect increases the Dodge Rate of allied units by 20%.
[Throne Lv.30]Upon landing, Khamsin's Shelter deals 200% DMG and inflicts a Knockdown effect on units around the target.
[Throne Lv.40]Upon landing, Khamsin's Shelter deals 300% DMG and inflicts a Knockdown effect on units around the target.
[Throne Lv.10]Allies within the Aura restore Max HP equal to 100% of ATK per second.
[Throne Lv.20]Allies within the Aura restore Max HP equal to 150% of ATK per second.
[Throne Lv.30]When there are 3 allies within the Aura, own Heal efficiency and Shield Power increase by 50%.
[Throne Lv.40]When there are 3 allies within the Aura, own DMG taken decreases by 70%.
[Throne Lv.10]When Bastet triggers a Dodge, permanently gains 2.5% ATK, up to 25%.
[Throne Lv.20]When Bastet triggers a Dodge, permanently gains 5% ATK, up to 50%.
[Throne Lv.30]When Bastet has over 100% Dodge, her DMG dealt increases by 20%.
[Throne Lv.40]When Bastet triggers a Dodge, permanently gains 5% ATK, up to 60%.
[Throne Lv.10]After Unstoppable ends, taunts enemies within a 3-meter radius for 3s.
[Throne Lv.20]After Unstoppable ends, taunts enemies within a 3-meter radius for 5s.
[Throne Lv.40]After Unstoppable ends, taunts enemies within a 5-meter radius for 5s.
God of the Sky and Revenge
[Throne Lv.10]While in the Revenge state, DMG dealt to locked-on enemies increases by 30%.
[Throne Lv.20]While in the Revenge state, DMG dealt to locked-on enemies increases by 50%.
[Throne Lv.30]While in the Revenge state, DMG taken from non-locked-on enemies decreases by 50%.
[Throne Lv.40]After casting Frenzied Blade, increases own ATK by 30% for 5s. This effect can stack.
[Throne Lv.10]Duration of Unyielding Will increases by 2s.
[Throne Lv.30]While Unyielding Will is active, securing a kill extends its duration by 3s.
[Throne Lv.40]Duration of Unyielding Will increases by 3s.
[Throne Lv.10]Sekhmet steals 15% of all stats from the Duel target (up to 75% of her own corresponding stats).
[Throne Lv.20]Upon entering battle, gains 10 stacks of Roaring Fury.
[Throne Lv.30]Sekhmet steals 20% of all stats from the Duel target (up to 100% of her own corresponding stats).
[Throne Lv.40]Sekhmet steals 25% of all stats from the Duel target (up to 125% of her own corresponding stats).
[Throne Lv.10]Taking DMG increases own Armor and M-RES by 5%, up to 20 stacks.
[Throne Lv.20]Taking DMG increases own Armor and M-RES by 10%, up to 20 stacks.
[Throne Lv.30]When max stacks are reached, refreshes the uses of Phantom Puppet (only once).
[Throne Lv.40]Taking DMG increases own Armor and M-RES by 12%, up to 20 stacks.
God of Dawn and the Scarab
[Throne Lv.10]Each instance of DMG from Khepri's Ultimate reduces the target's M-RES by 10% for 10s, stacking up to 5 times.
[Throne Lv.20]Each instance of DMG from Khepri's Ultimate reduces the target's M-RES by 20% for 10s, stacking up to 5 times.
[Throne Lv.30]While Khepri is in the Scarab's Blessing state, restores 100 Energy per second.
[Throne Lv.40]Each instance of DMG from Khepri's Ultimate reduces the target's M-RES by 25% for 10s, stacking up to 5 times.
[Throne Lv.10]At the start of battle, summons a butterfly on the nearest 1 front-row ally. After 4s, the butterfly deals DMG equal to 150% of ATK and inflicts a 3s Stun to enemies within 3 meters.
[Throne Lv.20]At the start of battle, summons a butterfly on the nearest 1 front-row ally. After 4s, the butterfly deals DMG equal to 150% of ATK and inflicts a 4s Stun to enemies within 3 meters.
[Throne Lv.30]At the start of battle, summons butterflies on the nearest 2 front-row allies. After 4s, the butterflies deal DMG equal to 150% of ATK and inflict a 4s Stun to enemies within 3 meters.
[Throne Lv.40]At the start of battle, summons butterflies on the nearest 2 front-row allies. After 4s, the butterflies deal DMG equal to 150% of ATK and inflict a 5s Stun to enemies within 3 meters.
[Throne Lv.10]The first time Nemesis deals DMG to each enemy Deity unit, she permanently gains 30% ATK, up to 5 stacks.
[Throne Lv.30]The first time Nemesis secures a kill, she permanently gains 50% Lifesteal.
God of the Sea and Quakes
[Throne Lv.10]When inflicting Crowd Control effects, Poseidon gains a shield equal to 50% of ATK.
[Throne Lv.20]When inflicting Crowd Control effects, Poseidon gains a shield equal to 100% of ATK.
[Throne Lv.30]Poseidon takes 40% less DMG while shielded.
[Throne Lv.40]Poseidon takes 50% less DMG while shielded.
[Throne Lv.10]Hela gains 100 initial Energy upon entering battle.
[Throne Lv.20]Hela gains 300 initial Energy upon entering battle.
[Throne Lv.30]Refreshes the CD of Blight upon Life after casting the Ultimate.
[Throne Lv.40]Hela gains 400 initial Energy upon entering battle.
Throne of the Serpent and Gaze
[Throne Lv.10]Medusa gains 40% ATK SPD after casting her Ultimate.
[Throne Lv.20]After dealing DMG 3 times to a target with the "Serpent Kiss" mark, Medusa petrifies them for 1 s.
[Throne Lv.30]After dealing DMG 3 times to a target with the "Serpent Kiss" mark, Medusa petrifies them for 2 s.
[Throne Lv.40]Medusa gains 60% ATK SPD after casting her Ultimate.
Throne of the Nether and Dark Moon
[Throne Lv.10]Increases Hecate's healing effects received by 30%.
[Throne Lv.20]When casting the Ultimate, also steals 2% Physical & Magical Resistance from enemy units on the field, up to 100% of own Physical & Magical Resistance.
[Throne Lv.30]Increases Hecate's healing effects received by 50%.
[Throne Lv.40]Increases Hecate's healing effects received by 60%.
